Placemaker.Commercial.plotDepth.Tooltip: How deep the shop plots reach from their street or lane (whole 8 m zone cells).
Placemaker.Commercial.lotSize.Tooltip: How many parking aisles deep the lots are.
Placemaker.Commercial.lotGreen.Tooltip: Planting in the parking lots: none, along the edges, or in medians between the rows.
Placemaker.Commercial.evShare.Tooltip: Share of parking bays with an EV charger.
Placemaker.Commercial.amount.Tooltip: How much of the street frontage becomes shop plots.
Placemaker.Commercial.lot.Tooltip: A small car park on the street, in the middle of the frontage.
Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.NoStreet: No existing street runs along the area: shops need one to face (it became a small park).
Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.NoLot: There was no room for a parking lot.

Placemaker.Recipe.StripMall.Description: A parking lot on the street with a row of shops facing it across a lane.
Placemaker.StripMall.Name: Strip mall
Placemaker.StripMall.style.Tooltip: Classic: lot in front, shops behind. Corner: lot on the corner, shops wrap it. Rear alley: shops on the street, lot behind.
Placemaker.StripMall.frontage.Tooltip: How much of the street the strip mall takes; it stays centred.
Placemaker.Recipe.ShoppingPlaza.Descript: Shops round a central court (square, market, parking or green) with a lane in between.
Placemaker.ShoppingPlaza.Name: Shopping plaza
Placemaker.ShoppingPlaza.court.Tooltip: What fills the court the shops face.
Placemaker.ShoppingPlaza.courtWidth.Tool: Width of the court along the street.
Placemaker.ShoppingPlaza.sideLots.Toolti: Parking lots on the street beside the shops.
Placemaker.Recipe.OutdoorMall.Descriptio: A pedestrian shopping street with shops on both sides, a plaza at its end and parking beside it.
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.Name: Outdoor mall
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.style.Tooltip: Promenade: one pedestrian street. Grand: a wide one. Loop: a pedestrian loop with shops on both sides.
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.plazaSize.Tooltip: Size of the plaza at the end of the street (0 = none).
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.spineLength.Toolt: Longest the pedestrian street may run into the area.
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.sideLots.Tooltip: Parking lots on the street beside the shops.
Placemaker.Recipe.ShopsPark.Description: A park woven between shop plots, with a small car park.
Placemaker.ShopsPark.Name: Shops & park
Placemaker.ShopsPark.layout.Tooltip: How the shop plots sit between the park and the street.
Placemaker.ShopsPark.parkStyle.Tooltip: Style of the park between the shops.
